name: Galbot G1
summary: G1 is a wheeled humanoid with two 7-DoF arms on a four-wheel omnidirectional base and a height-adjustable torso. Galbot uses it in warehouses, hospital pharmacies and its own autonomous retail stores in China.

payload_kg.original: Single arm capacity: 5 kg; combined: 10 kg

dof.original: Total 21 DoF: neck (2), dual arms (7x2), waist (3), legs (2)

hands: Interchangeable end effectors: dexterous hand, suction cup or gripper.
sensors: Head stereo cameras, four torso RGB cameras, two wrist depth cameras, 3D LiDAR, eight ultrasonic sensors.
highlights: The Robot Report says G1 has run 24/7 warehouse operations for over a year.
Used at Xuanwu Hospital in patient rooms and pharmacies, and in Galbot Store retail locations across 30+ Chinese cities.
Battery is 48 V 30 Ah with a 3.5-hour charge time.
caveats: Wheeled base, not a legged humanoid.

sources.title: Galbot brings in $300M to scale mobile manipulator deployments
